integrity: Two local, independent verification implementations and their captured outputs accompany a complete all-size elementary proof. This is not independent certification; unindexed equivalent prior results remain possible.
scientific_limitations: The exact counts and two-step stabilization hold for two complementary-pair majority networks only; no full basin-size formula is asserted. The cited 1980 foundational paper has only year-resolved earliest release evidence; the July 15, 2013 preprint has date-resolved public evidence.
title: One universal vertex exponentially suppresses majority two-cycles on cocktail-party graphs
